legacy_single_scenario.scope: Exactly three decisions, slots [0,1,2], clock 0..2, timer-only events, empty outcomes.

scenario_v1.scope: Three decisions at [0,1,2], clock 0..2; outcome-only scenarios.

scenario_v2.scope: 1..6 decisions and declared fixed slots; terminal goal.

versions.migration: Explicit opt-in only. Explorer /1 and scenario /1-/3 retain their previous grammars and meanings. No automatic conversion of old declarations, fixtures, pins or archived run packages.

purpose.meaning: Technical integration scope only. Descriptive business interpretation does not widen accepted purpose. No customer-value, real-world truth, probability, optimality or production applicability certification.
purpose.replay_boundary: The generic ce3-run/1 format has no purpose field. Explorer entry points enforce the listed purpose; generic replay is not a pilot-admission bypass or a semantic customer-data detector.

validation.explorer: Strict version-specific exact fields; nonempty typed predicates; no coercion. Whole materialized CE3 input is validated before freeze, including unused rules and external bindings.
validation.source_of_authority: Executable validators plus their versioned format contracts; this document does not add accepted inputs.

explorer.population: All n! permutations of the complete declared decision set; no pruning or rule evaluation by generator.

clock.slot_types: integer only, excluding bool, float and string

scenarios.labels: unique nonblank strings; different labels with identical outcomes remain distinct
scenarios.outcomes: Exactly every external event, including unused events, bound to a valid declared outcome; timer events may coexist. No missing bindings, patches, model overrides or probabilities.
scenarios.absent: Explicit declared absent/waiting outcome at scheduled event phase; not omitted data, guard failure or a predicted future response.

legacy_terminal.predicate: Nonempty conjunction of typed state equalities at inclusive horizon.

history.conjunction: Nonempty all list, unique nonblank component IDs; every component must hold on every path.
history.predicate: Nonempty equals map of declared fields to in-domain typed constants; all equalities at the same snapshot. Boolean true differs from integer 1.
history.time_limits: Integer through/deadline within [model.clock.start, model.clock.horizon], inclusive; negative integers allowed, bool/float/string rejected.
history.points: Every audited history row in index order, before then after, including initial, marker, event, decision, blocked and inapplicable rows. Duplicates retained. Time is row[side].step, not row.step; advance.before=t, advance.after=t+1.

always.quantification: for every point p with start <= time(p) <= through: predicate(p)

reach_by.quantification: there exists a point p with start <= time(p) <= deadline: predicate(p)

history.cross_path_quantification: For every audited path, for every component: its predicate/temporal condition holds. For reach_by this is FOR ALL paths EXISTS a witness per component/path, not EXISTS one shared witness FOR ALL paths.
history.boundary_cases: Initial and transient success suffice for reach_by even if later lost; drop and recovery at the same step violates always. Events and decisions at limit included. Different components may use different witnesses.
history.atomicity: No observable internal suboperations of atomic transitions; no interpolation, continuous-time measurement or inferred effects of pending events.
history.evidence: Complete ordered row_index/side/step references and inclusive interval; first witness for successful reach_by, first counterexample for failed universal check, terminal state for terminal. Recomputed after fresh full audit.

acceptance.scope: whole run, including decisions after component deadlines
acceptance.executed_rows: Legacy explorer /1 and scenario /1-/3 require all n model decisions. Scenario /4 requires exactly the k selected script entries, with matching decisions, times, order and script_position; every matched row must be decision_executed.
acceptance.cell_goal: conjunction of path_goal over ALL fully audited event paths
acceptance.selection: Scenario /4 rederives required/group membership and canonical prefix script from trusted input. An operational replay/audit PASS does not authorize a selection-invalid script.
acceptance.omission: Omitted optional decisions are not blocked attempts; selected but blocked decisions fail the combined goal even if all state components hold.

goals.certification_gate: Fresh audit PASS, verified=true and all_event_permutations=true, with expected input and complete identity bindings, precedes all projections. No partial-path proofs; errors, limits, missing paths or corruption yield UNKNOWN/null, even when partial traces appear decisive.

selected_history.conjunction: Nonempty all list, unique nonblank component IDs; every component must hold on every path.
selected_history.predicate: Nonempty equals map of declared fields to in-domain typed constants; all equalities at the same snapshot. Boolean true differs from integer 1.
selected_history.time_limits: Integer through/deadline within [model.clock.start, model.clock.horizon], inclusive; negative integers allowed, bool/float/string rejected.
selected_history.points: Every audited history row in index order, before then after, including initial, marker, event, decision, blocked and inapplicable rows. Duplicates retained. Time is row[side].step, not row.step; advance.before=t, advance.after=t+1.

always.quantification: for every point p with start <= time(p) <= through: predicate(p)

reach_by.quantification: there exists a point p with start <= time(p) <= deadline: predicate(p)

selected_history.cross_path_quantification: For every audited path, for every component: its predicate/temporal condition holds. For reach_by this is FOR ALL paths EXISTS a witness per component/path, not EXISTS one shared witness FOR ALL paths.
selected_history.boundary_cases: Initial and transient success suffice for reach_by even if later lost; drop and recovery at the same step violates always. Events and decisions at limit included. Different components may use different witnesses.
selected_history.atomicity: No observable internal suboperations of atomic transitions; no interpolation, continuous-time measurement or inferred effects of pending events.
selected_history.evidence: Complete ordered row_index/side/step references and inclusive interval; first witness for successful reach_by, first counterexample for failed universal check, terminal state for terminal. Recomputed after fresh full audit.
selected_history.temporal_semantics: Exactly the existing terminal/always/reach_by operators and snapshot-time sampling of history goal /1; only attempt scope and selection evidence extend the contract.

robustness.scope: Each fixed candidate over its entire declared scenario set; all audited event paths inside each scenario cell.
robustness.FALSE: At least one CERTIFIED scenario cell has goal=false, even if others are UNKNOWN.
robustness.TRUE: Every declared scenario cell is CERTIFIED and goal=true.
robustness.UNKNOWN: No certified refutation and at least one uncertified or unrun scenario cell.
robustness.interpretation: Not probability, general robustness beyond declared scenarios, or evidence of real-world completeness.

selected_explorer.partition: Required R and optional O are unique nonblank string-ID lists, disjoint, whose union is exactly all model decision IDs U. R or O may be empty.

groups.members: At least two distinct IDs, all in O; groups pairwise disjoint; unique nonblank group IDs.
groups.selection: R subset A subset U; exactly one member from each exactly_one group, at most one from each at_most_one group; ungrouped optional IDs chosen independently.
groups.no_operational_filtering: Selection never evaluates guards, effects, costs or outcomes; syntactically valid blocked plans remain in the population.

selected_explorer.candidate: Every permutation of every valid selected set; each selected ID attempted exactly once. No retry or early stop.

clock.slot_types: integer only, excluding bool, float and string
clock.candidate_times: A word of length k uses exactly slots[0:k]; remaining slots produce no keys or empty entries.
clock.omission_consequence: Removing X from PXU at [0,2,4] yields PU at [0,2], not P@0,U@4. Omission can change goal outcomes by advancing later attempts. No hidden WAIT or time-choice dimension.

allow_empty.conditions: Empty selected set only if allow_empty=true AND R is empty AND no exactly_one group requires a member. Does not override other constraints.
allow_empty.execution: Full horizon, initial events and every event path still run and require complete audit.
allow_empty.goal: Zero attempts gives vacuous attempt acceptance after full audit, not automatic truth of temporal/state components.

selected_explorer.model_preservation: All model rules, sources, initial state, clock and complete external outcomes remain present and validated, including omitted decisions and unused events. Omitted decisions make no attempts, debit or schedule.

population.polynomial: P(z)=z^r (1+z)^f product(a_i z) product(1+b_j z); r=|R|, f=ungrouped optional count, a_i=exactly_one sizes, b_j=at_most_one sizes.
population.cells: M=C*S for the nonempty declared scenario list
population.independent_expected: bitmask cardinality checks then factorial-rank decoding; exact population and contents reconstructed during freeze/verify
population.shared_helpers: Validation, codec and small identity/materialization helpers are shared; independent direct full-input oracles test that boundary.

execution_order: lexicographic word order across all sets of that length

scenarios.labels: unique nonblank strings; different labels with identical outcomes remain distinct
scenarios.outcomes: Exactly every external event, including unused events, bound to a valid declared outcome; timer events may coexist. No missing bindings, patches, model overrides or probabilities.
scenarios.absent: Explicit declared absent/waiting outcome at scheduled event phase; not omitted data, guard failure or a predicted future response.

selected_explorer.canonicalization: Sort R/O, group members and groups by group ID for selection/search identity; preserve slots and candidate order. Set-list reordering preserves search/candidate/plan, but the exact original problem and pins change. Scenario order is identity- and budget-significant. No ID normalization.
selected_explorer.identity: Selection/group kind/allow_empty binds selection and search identities even if a particular script is unchanged. Candidate binds search_space_id and plan_id. Redundant selected_ids/omitted_ids/order must match actual canonical script; rehashing cannot substitute for domain reconstruction.

run_verification.meaning: Audited execution and artifact bindings; CERTIFIED does not mean the goal is true.

goal_assessment.meaning: true/false only for certified full runs; otherwise null. An accepted negative is valid evidence, not a process failure.

search_coverage.enumeration: Exact expected cell membership AND content, no duplicates or unexpected cells.
search_coverage.candidate_coverage: Each candidate represented by at least one certified scenario cell.
search_coverage.scenario_coverage: Each scenario represented by at least one certified candidate cell.
search_coverage.cell_coverage: Entire candidate x scenario crossing, certification, enumeration and execution-prefix validity.
search_coverage.event_path_coverage: Per-cell COMPLETE only after fresh audit of every simultaneous event permutation; otherwise UNKNOWN with null count.
search_coverage.warning: Complete candidate and scenario projections do not imply complete cell coverage; complete coverage does not imply satisfied goals.

batch_validity.top_level: Invalid declarations, pins, runtime/build or batch specification are rejected (CLI 1).
batch_validity.reportable_invalidity: Invalid enumeration or execution prefix yields cell_coverage INVALID (CLI 2), even if some cells are individually certified.
batch_validity.execution_rule: Every retained runs entry, including empty, input-only, started-only and failure-only, consumes an attempt and must be within the first max_cells positions; retained count <= max_cells. /1-/3 use candidate lexical order then declared scenario order; /4 uses candidate length, lexical word, declared scenario order. Verify reconstructs order from declared domain, never saved enumeration. Missing entries remain UNKNOWN; chronological execution and wholly erased attempts are not attested.
batch_validity.incomplete: Missing certification/short execution can yield INCOMPLETE (CLI 2).
batch_validity.complete: CLI 0 means complete verified cell coverage, including when all goals are false.
batch_validity.cell_findings: Unaffected certified cells remain reportable; a robust result does not repair batch invalidity.

replay.max_paths: maximum live paths after expansion, all permutations or none
replay.max_rows: maximum newly emitted work rows across the branch tree, excluding copied shared prefixes
replay.max_steps: maximum integer steps from start through horizon
replay.partial_diagnostics: last committed snapshot and history; no complete paths certified

explorer.max_cells: Execution budget 0..full population, default full; distinct from 2160 support bound.
explorer.budget_exhaustion: Full expected population retained; remaining cells NOT_RUN, goal UNKNOWN, event coverage UNKNOWN.
explorer.size_gate: 720 candidates and 2160 cells are support gates before enumeration/materialization/output, independent of execution max_cells. Small/zero budget cannot admit an oversized domain. Event-path growth, model size and total runtime are not bounded by C/M.

audit.verify: Read-only: reconstruct frozen domain, check external pins and current code/runtime identities, freshly audit history, recompute full observations/evidence and compare records. Does not replay, write artifacts or trust saved result.json.
audit.trust: Separately trusted pins, trusted code and stable files. Hashes bind content; not signatures, execution attestation or truth of source/model. Erased complete attempt history is not reconstructed.

unsupported.layer_scope: Replay supports attempt and if_not_taken scripts; explorer generates attempt only. Replay alternative_plan_search exclusion remains true within replay; the bounded wrapper supports fixed permutations and /4 selected fixed plans. This does not provide a general operating model, policy solver or business-truth certification.

engine_target.meaning: Recommended engine reference for a future explicitly assessed compiler/adapter, not a claim of implemented onboarding/SR feature coverage.

onboarding.required_future_work: Separately assess translation and SR coverage for exact /4 grammar, required/optional choices, groups, prefix effects, empty plans, temporal goals, scenarios, evidence and purpose. Customer confirmation or a complete SR receipt is not execution/goal certification.

observed_layer_support.session: Versioned proposal/source/review/confirmation archives and handoff ready_for_separate_compilation_and_validation; ce3_validation_status and ce3_run_status remain not_run.
observed_layer_support.SR: Structured-grounded adapter with pinned SR code, coverage and receipts; recorded-response offline checks and archived-result interfaces are not proof of live quality or executable CE3 translation.
observed_layer_support.not_established: No support claim for compiling or semantically reviewing /4 selections, prefix timing or candidate-relative acceptance. This integration does not migrate onboarding capability context or SR.
